== English Tatooine comparison ==
Decipher publishes the complete two-mode replacement and explicitly identifies you as the player who just lost the armed character. The printed face says ‘If just lost’. This clarifies the already implied actor. The current marked D-E1 face and printable slip have the same replacement words. Keep the Decipher attribution and avoid inventing a separate PC gameplay state for later attestations.
